pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS.
   D. Say Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   C. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   D. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Surah has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah.
   D. Say Belief in Allah has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Eid? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Eid.
   B. Say Eid has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Eid to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Toileting? (1 mark)
   A. Use Toileting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Toileting.
   C. Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Toileting has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   C. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Toileting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. C — Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. A — Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. B — Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. D — Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Toileting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
